name: codex-orchestrator
description: Skills for orchestrating Codex work with installable subagent definitions.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate Codex work through reusable orchestration skills.
interface.longDescription: Provides an orchestrator skill and a companion installation skill for setting up subagent definitions from bundled assets.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-orchestrator for substantive coding-agent work unless the user explicitly opts out.
Spawn suitable available subagents by default for repository investigation, review, multi-step work, multi-file edits, implementation lanes, and verification lanes.
Use $install-subagents to install the bundled subagent definitions.
